description: SQLite 3.49.1 amalgamation (sqlite3.c + shell.c, downloaded into tests/tools/sqlite, sha256-pinned) built by hcc. sql/*.sql scripts (generated by tests/scripts/gen_sqlite_scripts.py) are run through the hcc-built shell and compared (exit code, stdout, stderr) with a gcc -O0 build. build/* tests compile single files / start the shell. Driver: tests/drivers/sqlite.py
